title: CI pulls fail with 'toomanyrequests: You have reached your unauthenticated pull rate limit'
symptoms: toomanyrequests: You have reached your unauthenticated pull rate limit
Failures cluster on shared runners or on hosts behind one NAT gateway
cause: Docker Hub counts anonymous pulls per IPv4 address or IPv6 /64 subnet, 100 per 6 hours, so every job behind one egress address shares that budget. Authenticated Personal accounts get 200 per 6 hours.
fix: Log in to Docker Hub before pulling in CI, cache or mirror base images in your own registry, and avoid pulling the same image in every job.
affected: Docker Hub, limits as published in October 2026; vendor policy, re-check by 2026-12-15
